core.title: Decorative Bronze Patina Mail Slot, Hamilton MS-301-BP

text.description_html:
Hamilton MS-301-BP, Bronze Patina Decorative Letter Slots

This gorgeous letter box is 10 inches long by 3 inches high. It is made out of solid bronze and has a bronze patina finish. The lavish embellishments around it give this Hamilton mail slot timelessness. As easily as it would look just right on the door to a classically styled building this letter mail slot would compliment more modern architecture. What is best about this mail slot is its ability to make an interesting statement without having to adhere to a specific time period or setting; and it is made with high quality backed up by a lifetime warranty.

The Bronze Patina Finish is hand rubbed for a superior high quality finished product. Give your home or office a center piece an elegant touch that you can be extremely proud of.

Features of the Hamilton MS-301-BP Bronze Decorative Mail Slot:

  • Finish: Bronze Patina
  • Material: Solid Bronze.
  • Length: 10"
  • Height: 3"
  • Packaged with both Exterior and Interior mail doors.
  • Packaged complete with mounting hardware.
  • Limited Lifetime Warranty.

Sold Individually




** This item is discontinued.
